name: CLOUDCUSP LLMS.txt Generator
author: CLOUDCUSP

sections.description:
The LLMS.txt Generator plugin creates AI-friendly content files that help search engines and AI bots better understand and index your website content. This plugin provides a comprehensive solution for managing how AI systems interact with your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Automatic LLMS.txt Generation: Creates properly formatted files that AI bots can easily parse
  • Modern Admin Interface: Beautiful, responsive dashboard with intuitive controls
  • Content Management: Bulk actions, filtering, and individual post control
  • Bot Analytics: Track which AI bots are accessing your content
  • Scheduled Generation: Automated file updates via WordPress cron
  • SEO Integration: Works with Yoast, RankMath, and All in One SEO
  • Email Notifications: Get notified of file generation and bot activity
  • Multisite Support: Works seamlessly with WordPress multisite networks
  • Custom Content: Override auto-generated descriptions with custom content
  • Debug Logging: Comprehensive logging for troubleshooting

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Configure your settings in the WordPress admin
  3. The plugin automatically generates an LLMS.txt file at yoursite.com/llms.txt
  4. AI bots can access this file to better understand your content
  5. Monitor bot activity through the analytics dashboard

Supported Post Types

  • Posts
  • Pages
  • Custom Post Types
  • WooCommerce Products (if installed)

SEO Plugin Integration

  • Yoast SEO
  • RankMath
  • All in One SEO Pack
  • SEOPress

Additional Information

Support

For support, please visit our website or contact us through the WordPress.org support forums.

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Please visit our GitHub repository to contribute to the development of this plugin.

Privacy

This plugin collects minimal data for analytics purposes:
* Bot user agents and IP addresses for analytics
* File generation timestamps and statistics
* No personal user data is collected or transmitted

All data is stored locally in your WordPress database and is not shared with third parties.

Installation Guide

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “LLMS.txt Generator”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Navigate to LLMS Generator in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Configure your basic settings:
    • Enable/disable the plugin
    • Set your site title and tagline
    • Choose which post types to include
    • Set content preferences
  3. Save your settings
  4. Click “Generate Now” to create your first LLMS.txt file
  5. Visit yoursite.com/llms.txt to verify the file was created

Advanced Configuration

  • Cron Settings: Set up automated file generation
  • Email Notifications: Configure email alerts
  • Content Management: Fine-tune which content is included
  • Analytics: Monitor bot activity and file access
  • Debug Logging: Enable detailed logging for troubleshooting

Troubleshooting

File Not Generated

  1. Check file permissions on your WordPress root directory
  2. Verify that WordPress cron is enabled
  3. Check the debug logs in Advanced Settings
  4. Ensure the plugin is activated and enabled

Bot Analytics Not Working

  1. Verify that the file is accessible at yoursite.com/llms.txt
  2. Check that analytics logging is enabled
  3. Wait for bots to discover and access your file
  4. Check server logs for any access errors

Cron Jobs Not Running

  1. Verify WordPress cron is not disabled
  2. Check with your hosting provider about cron job support
  3. Test manual generation to ensure the plugin works

Performance Issues

  1. Check if file generation is running too frequently
  2. Reduce the number of posts included
  3. Consider using a caching plugin

For additional support, please visit our documentation or contact support.

sections.faq:
What is an LLMS.txt file?

An LLMS.txt file is a standardized format that helps AI systems and large language models better understand and index your website content. It provides structured information about your site’s pages and posts.

Will this affect my site’s performance?

No, the plugin is designed to be lightweight and efficient. File generation happens in the background, and the generated file is cached for optimal performance.

Can I customize which content is included?

Yes, you have full control over which post types and individual posts are included in the LLMS.txt file. You can also add custom descriptions for any post.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with popular caching plugins. The LLMS.txt file is served directly and bypasses most caching systems.

Can I schedule automatic updates?

Yes, you can configure the plugin to automatically regenerate the file on a schedule (hourly, daily, weekly) or when content is published/updated.
